probe: bar-parity of the tr_M-paired number from the HH^1 outer class
trace_convention: Ocneanu/Markov, Jones specialization per docs/audits/2026-08-04-ocneanu-trace-parameter-audit.md; z kept SYMBOLIC and bar-EVEN (true of z = 1/(q^{1/2}+q^{-1/2})). Keeping z formal avoids a q^{1/2} branch choice at the root of unity AND makes the conclusion independent of the Ocneanu-parameter question that audit records as genuinely open.
generator_pin: He-Nie minimal-length conjugacy-class representatives (e, s1, s1s2 for n=3) -- asserted to form a basis of HH_0, so the generator is pinned structurally, not chosen.

assertions.name: trace_kills_commutators[q = i        ([2]_q = 0)]
assertions.detail: tr_M vanishes on all 36 commutators [B_i,B_j] (validates the Ocneanu recursion + the descent to HH_0)

assertions.name: henie_minlength_basis[q = i        ([2]_q = 0)]
assertions.detail: the 3 minimal-length conjugacy-class representatives (e, s1, s1s2) project to a BASIS of HH_0 -- the generator pin is structural (He-Nie), not a choice

assertions.name: bar_decomposition_valid[q = i        ([2]_q = 0)]
assertions.detail: each S_even is bar-even, each S_odd is bar-odd, and the parts re-sum to S

assertions.name: jones_z_is_bar_even[q = i        ([2]_q = 0)]
assertions.detail: z = 1/(2cos(theta/2)) = sqrt(2)/2 is REAL, hence bar-even -- the hypothesis held on z is verified

assertions.name: bar_odd_survives_jones_z[q = i        ([2]_q = 0)]
assertions.detail: at least one bar-ODD component is still nonzero after specializing z to the Jones value (not a formal-z artifact)

assertions.name: trace_kills_commutators[q = zeta_6   ([3]_q = 0)]
assertions.detail: tr_M vanishes on all 36 commutators [B_i,B_j] (validates the Ocneanu recursion + the descent to HH_0)

assertions.name: henie_minlength_basis[q = zeta_6   ([3]_q = 0)]
assertions.detail: the 3 minimal-length conjugacy-class representatives (e, s1, s1s2) project to a BASIS of HH_0 -- the generator pin is structural (He-Nie), not a choice

assertions.name: bar_decomposition_valid[q = zeta_6   ([3]_q = 0)]
assertions.detail: each S_even is bar-even, each S_odd is bar-odd, and the parts re-sum to S

assertions.name: jones_z_is_bar_even[q = zeta_6   ([3]_q = 0)]
assertions.detail: z = 1/(2cos(theta/2)) = sqrt(3)/3 is REAL, hence bar-even -- the hypothesis held on z is verified

assertions.name: bar_odd_survives_jones_z[q = zeta_6   ([3]_q = 0)]
assertions.detail: at least one bar-ODD component is still nonzero after specializing z to the Jones value (not a formal-z artifact)

assertions.name: trace_kills_commutators[q = 2        (semisimple control)]
assertions.detail: tr_M vanishes on all 36 commutators [B_i,B_j] (validates the Ocneanu recursion + the descent to HH_0)

assertions.name: henie_minlength_basis[q = 2        (semisimple control)]
assertions.detail: the 3 minimal-length conjugacy-class representatives (e, s1, s1s2) project to a BASIS of HH_0 -- the generator pin is structural (He-Nie), not a choice

results.label: q = i        ([2]_q = 0)
results.verdict: NOT trace-blind: tr_M(Delta(x)) != 0, so the clean scale-invariant prune does not occur. The paired number is MIXED -- it carries a NONZERO bar-ODD component, which is the parity the c_3 swing needs. The outer class is therefore NOT excluded by bar-parity.

results.verdict: NOT trace-blind: tr_M(Delta(x)) != 0, so the clean scale-invariant prune does not occur. The paired number is MIXED -- it carries a NONZERO bar-ODD component, which is the parity the c_3 swing needs. The outer class is therefore NOT excluded by bar-parity.
